scan_scope: All staged file bytes and filenames; complete fixed-layout binary STL payloads and normalized headers; all text decoded; source private identifiers and reference URLs checked in memory without retaining their values.
excluded_content: Actual-building reference material, images, screenshots, thumbnails, archives, printer code, private account/contact metadata and reference location information excluded.
limits: STL coordinates are authorized local Cartesian mesh geometry. No geographic inputs included. Checks establish digital integrity and source consistency, not physical fit or final assembly.
